facts.fact: 日记的核心断言：美国中央情报局为了“保护国家安全”而发明了 WikiLeaks
facts.anchor: To protect national security, the United States Central Intelligence Agency invented WikiLeaks.

facts.fact: 交给 Manning、再转给 Assange 的秘密电文来自国务院，而国务院是 CIA 在官僚体系里的死敌
facts.anchor: They came from the Department of State, CIA’s sworn bureaucratic enemy!

facts.fact: Assange 只靠两条永远脏着的裤子过活，本章标题即此
facts.anchor: By the way, did you know agent provocateur Julian Assange gets by owning just two pairs of trousers, both of which are always soiled?

facts.fact: 叙述者说这两条脏裤子是 Assange 为掩护身份想出的办法
facts.anchor: It’s for his cover, and he thought it up all by himself.

facts.fact: 叙述者责怪读者没读过那 251,287 条 WikiLeaks 电文
facts.anchor: you haven’t bothered to read the 251,287 WikiLeaks cables

facts.fact: Manning 为保护身份秘密付出的代价包括 35 年刑期
facts.anchor: Along with a 35-year jail sentence to protect zir cover.

facts.fact: CIA 曾训练阿富汗人杀苏联人、发赏金、配毒刺导弹，随后撤离
facts.anchor: CIA trains a bunch of Afghans to kill Soviets, pays them bounties, arms them with Stinger missiles

facts.fact: CIA 的标准规划窗口只有两年，因此没人做长期打算
facts.anchor: With two years as your standard CIA planning window
